purpose: Teach: 恐ろしく/耐える/説い/ただちに/従わ/免れ/我ら/ですけれど

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、雷が恐ろしく鳴ってるけど、お父さんがいらっしゃるから大丈夫
lines.en: Sho — the thunder's really loud out there, but Dad's here, so you're safe.
lines.style: Warm, protective tone. Soft opening. Gentle reassurance without urgency. Voice settles lower as if creating a small, safe space with just the sound of her presence.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、寒さに耐える練習してるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I'm practicing getting used to being cold.
lines.style: Quiet determination under the words. Not seeking praise. A small, genuine observation of something he's noticed about himself. Slight upward lilt at the end—matter-of-fact but hoping she notices.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが翔くんに人の大切さを説いて下さるわね
lines.en: Sho — Dad's going to teach you something important about how much people mean to each other.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost musing. Speaking more to herself than at him. Recognising something happening beyond the immediate moment. Pace slows on the last phrase.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんが「ただちに来てね」って仰ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Dad said to come right away.
lines.style: Simple, direct report. No drama in the delivery. The urgency is in the message, not the voice. Slight rise on the final word—checking she understood the instruction correctly.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんに従わないと迷子になっちゃうわよ
lines.en: Sho — if you don't do what Dad says, you'll get lost.
lines.style: Practical guidance with a hint of concern beneath it. Not bossy—more like she's passing on something important she learned. Slight lean forward in the phrasing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、テストを免れたいなんて思わないよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I'm not trying to skip the test.
lines.style: Quiet insistence. Defending something about himself without anger. The words matter more than the delivery—he means this. Small, steady voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、我ら家族は強い絆で結ばれてるわ
lines.en: Sho — our family—we're all held together by something strong.
lines.style: Tender but sure. Not sentimental. Each word given its weight. Voice carries quiet conviction. Slight warm breath before the final word.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さん、お疲れですけれど、お話しできて嬉しい
lines.en: Mei-sis — Dad's tired, but I'm glad we could talk.
lines.style: Soft observation. Noticing something true without complaint. Warmth underneath the acknowledgment of fatigue. Voice fades slightly at the end, like a quiet closing.
